questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
It was a bit difficult because I didn't want to live in co-living, and the places that offered single rooms gave priority to Norwegians who could stay there for a year rather than six months. In the end, they spent so much time on the process that the first ones offered me a room after I had already started. So I had to pay a little extra and find an apartment in the city through
hybel.no
.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: There are busses everywhere and the city is not that big so it's not at problem at all.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Only master courses.
I had one course: Asset Pricing and Portfolio Management which was taught very differently as to what I'm used to and it was an extremely hard exam. As an exchange student be cautious before picking this course.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: A lot of self studying. Hardly any people were to the lectures compared to the one mandatory lecture. Also in the hard one mentioned earlier he just wrote down math on a piece of paper every lecture which had no assignment to it and therefore no lecture slides other than the math on paper.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
FIN3009: Asset Pricing and Portfolio Management
BFIN4015: Sustainable Finance
SØK3540: Political economy
FIN3010: Empirical methods in corporate finance

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
FIN3010: Empirical methods in corporate finance
BFIN4015: Sustainable Finance
Great courses and the exam form is just you writing a big assignment which you can start whenever. This of course is great if you just want to enjoy the exchange. However the lecture were also very informative especially FIN3010: Empirical methods in corporate finance

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: I mostly socialized with exchange students. But for local student co-living and different clubs are the best places to meet norwegian students.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: no

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: It's very safe.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Go hiking and try not to pick the same hikes
2. Some sort of club also if you have never tried the specific sport before
3. Try to focus on the social and pick courses that are not to hard. The hard courses are no joke at NTNU.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
All the apps you need
ATB: Public Transport
Blackboard: Same as absalon
Studentbevis: Mobile studentcard (a lot of places only accept the app and not even the physical card)
Mazemap: To get around on campus which at times is very confusing
SIT: For fitness

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting new people and being able to be in beautiful nature. Also I saw a lot of nothern lights.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Being "alone". I had not forced myself the first couple of days to be very social meet other people my stay would have been awful.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
